rule_gaps: Norwegian bed-linen vocabulary is unmapped and lands in Furniture: sengesett, laken/splittlaken, putevar, tisselaken, sengeteppe (17 rows here) all belong in Home
Rug words are unmapped and land in Furniture: ullteppe, fryseteppe/friezematte (4 rows here) belong in Home
Hagemøbler leaf crumbs that are NOT furniture still resolve to Furniture: 'Paviljonger og parasoller', 'Paviljongvegg', 'Parasoller og parasollføtter' should reach Garden
'Turmøbler' (packable camping furniture, Milrab/Widforss) resolves to Furniture; it is camping gear and should reach Outdoor
facetrules colour table reads model names as colours - 'Bordeaux' gives color Red on both Stressless Bordeaux tables
facetrules type table is driven by substrings: 'skrivebordsstol' gives Tables, 'sminkebord m/speil' gives Mirrors, 'sengegavl / benk' gives Chairs, 'sittepute for ... sofa' gives Sofas
dim is not derived from '90x200cm' (glued to cm), '70x40x82' (three axes) or '140*200' (asterisk separator)
colour words unmapped: lyserød, aqua, konjakk, mørkegrå, Anthracite, Ljusgrå (Swedish spellings in particular)
every one of the 300 rows carries icon 'sofa' - the Furniture default is never specialised, so a mattress, a rug and a parasol all render the same glyph
Fagmøbler rows take the model/series name as brand: 'Svane sengegavl', 'Svane Nocturne', 'Svane IntelliGel Zala', 'Svane Mila Plus', 'Sone dyp', 'Sone lav'
Trademax/Chilli publish untranslated Swedish names (Sängram, Soffbord, Skåp, Spjälsäng, Hörnbäddsoffa, Sängbord) and EAN-less slug ids fork the same product per shop-title spelling
notes: Category placement is broadly right - the leaks are systematic rather than random: 24 rows are bedding/rug textiles or decor that belong in Home, 4 are Garden (parasols, a pavilion wall), 2 Outdoor camping tables, 2 Baby, and one Black+Decker immersion blender that should be Kitchen. The bigger structural problem is duplication: 20+ rows are one product split across sizes or colours (8 Sängram Boisdale sizes, four Svane sengegavl families, three Stryn kommode, three Square Classic TV benk), and EAN-less p- slugs fork rows that already exist under an EAN. 79 of 300 rows still have no image.
